title: MultiChatLock
description: The Project: ChatLock, an emergency chat-freeze utility plugin designed to handle chat chaos, raid spam, or bot attacks instantly.
body:
# ChatLock

When your server chat hits peak chaos, every second counts. **ChatLock** is a lightweight, zero-bloat administration utility that gives your staff team absolute control over the chat stream during bot attacks, arguments, or raid attempts. 

---

## 🛠️ Features

* **Instant Toggle:** One single command (`/chatlock`) freezes or unfreezes global server chat instantly.
* **Immersive Visual Popups:** When the chat state changes, an elegant screen title and subtitle alert pops up for every single online player to grab their attention instantly.
* **Smart Permission Bypass:** Staff members with the admin permission node bypass the lock automatically, letting them coordinate cleanup efforts right in public chat.
* **Strict Error Reinforcement:** Keeps chat entirely clean. When a muted player tries to type, their text is intercepted and replaced with a clean, un-intrusive warning.
* **Zero Performance Impact:** Listens to modern asynchronous chat events without interrupting main server ticks.

---

## 🔒 Permissions & Integration

Hooks directly into vanilla Bukkit permission nodes to guarantee native, out-of-the-box integration with **LuckPerms**.

* `syntropic.chatlock.admin` - Grants permission to toggle the chat lock state, see admin logs, and talk freely while the lock is active.

---

## 📈 Compatibility

Engineered using universal, cross-version Paper and Spigot API methods. Designed to function flawlessly across older environments and modern server builds, fully supporting **Minecraft 26.1 and upwards** without maintenance required.

*Developed by Syntropic.*
